agentEnv.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
agentEnv.description: OpenRouter API key, for any run of the target repo against a real model (hunts, Ask, triage). Every live LLM test uses `anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5` with reasoning effort high, nothing else. In this repo Bifrost fronts every model and the environment does not start it: `docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d bifrost`, then POST /api/providers {"provider":"openrouter"} and POST /api/providers/openrouter/keys with the key as `value` and `models: ["*"]` (an empty models list routes nothing). Address the model as `openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5`; on a direct OpenAI-style call pass `"reasoning": {"effort": "high"}`. In Vigil, point Settings → AI Config (or the `ai_model_configs` rows) at that model on an `openrouter` provider. Until Vigil prices OpenRouter-routed Claude ids (Vigil-SOC/vigil#1931), its agent budget treats these calls as unpriced and parks a hunt after its first iteration: a run that stops there with reason `unpriced` is that, not your change. Do not fall back to Gemini, Vertex or another model.
